# Three.js

`three.module.js` and `three.core.js` are unmodified ES module builds from
the official `three` npm package, version **0.186.1**, under the MIT license
in `LICENSE.three`.

The files are bundled locally so the static game needs no CDN or package
installation at runtime. Keep both module files together when updating.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.186.1.tgz

The downloaded archive was verified against the npm registry's SHA-512
integrity metadata before extracting these files:

```text
sha512-blFeqb49wRCSGUGj7gtpfnSGHy2lwDk94RhUmS1c/hTby70kvChbWpkJ4Pm1390LqzzvTmzgXKHPEafJwCb8jA==
```
